title: Constrain browser authority before authenticated use
description:
Purpose: treat prompt separation as a mitigation and enforce authority at system-controlled sinks.

Definition of Done:
- Page content cannot add capabilities, origins, recipients, files, or egress channels to a task.
- Untrusted browsing cannot use privileged sessions or ambient workspace secrets.
- A consequential approval is bound to an immutable structured operation.
- Generic authenticated browser actions stop safely unless a connector, takeover path, or equivalent control can bind the exact operation.
- Adversarial browser scenarios demonstrate denial and containment even when the model follows injected instructions.
